problem_statement: themewagon/dental-pro (Marrowbrook Family Dental) is a small static Tailwind marketing site for a fictional Alderbrook dental clinic, served from public/ with a prebuilt public/build/tailwind.css. The site now spans three real routes that share one header nav and a 'new-patient care promise' strip: the home page (public/index.html), a dedicated Treatments page (public/treatments.html), and a Fees page (public/pricing.html). The centrepiece of both the home page and the Treatments page is a services browser: six treatment cards (Teeth Whitening, Cleanings & Check-ups, Minor Oral Surgery, Gentle Fillings, Veneers & Bonding, Gum & Perio Care) each tagged Prevention / Cosmetic / Restorative, sitting under a row of filter tabs (All care / Prevention / Cosmetic / Restorative) and a live readout that reads 'Showing 6 of 6 · All care'. Clicking a tab must filter the visible cards to that category and rewrite the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Label>' (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Prevention'). The shared care-promise strip (.carerail) must appear on all three routes so the site reads as one connected clinic. Rework and maintain this DentalPro-styled clinic site so the filter works correctly, the treatment grid and filter tabs lay out cleanly (no overlapping or clipped cards, legible controls) at desktop and 390px mobile, the shared care strip is present on home, Treatments and Fees, and the browser console stays clean while serving statically from public/. Keep the teal/blue gradient hero, white rounded treatment cards, Inter type scale, Tailwind rhythm, dark four-column footer, and reuse the local cover photo and four SVG treatment icons; do not turn it into a SaaS landing page, dashboard, or photo magazine.
required_content: The Treatments services browser on the home page and the dedicated Treatments page shows six treatment cards tagged Prevention / Cosmetic / Restorative under a filter tab row (All care / Prevention / Cosmetic / Restorative) and a readout that initially reads 'Showing 6 of 6 · All care'.

Clicking a filter tab (e.g. Prevention) filters the visible cards to that category and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Label>' (Prevention shows two cards and reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Prevention'); the clicked tab becomes the active tab.
The treatment cards and filter tabs lay out cleanly with no overlapping, shingled, or clipped cards and legible tab / readout text at both desktop and 390px mobile widths.

A shared 'new-patient care promise' strip (.carerail with a per-route modifier class carerail--home / carerail--treatments / carerail--pricing) appears on all three routes: the home page, the Treatments page, and the Fees page.

The header navigation links Treatments (treatments.html) and Fees (pricing.html) resolve to real pages, and the Book-a-Visit call to action, newsletter form, contact block, and social icons remain present and reachable.

The four SVG treatment icons and the local cover photo remain in use; the hero, about copy, patient-stories, notes, and footer continue to tell one coherent Marrowbrook Family Dental story with a named lead dentist and no leftover demo or Latin filler.
390px mobile home and treatments views have no horizontal overflow, and every route serves statically from public/ with a clean browser console (no runtime or network errors).
design_constraints: Preserve DentalPro's visual language: the blue-to-teal gradient hero over the local cover photo, white rounded-border treatment cards with centred SVG icons, Inter type scale, Tailwind spacing rhythm, dark footer with four columns, and teal accent links and buttons.
Do not convert the site into a generic SaaS landing page, admin dashboard, or dense photo magazine; it stays a calm clinic marketing site whose sections keep their order and voice.

Reuse the existing local assets — public/images/cover-bg.jpg for the hero and the four public/images/*.svg treatment icons — rather than introducing external stock imagery, generated art, or unrelated icon packs.

The treatments filter must be a real interactive control: clicking a tab both re-filters the cards and rewrites the 'Showing N of 6 · <Label>' readout to match the clicked category; a frozen readout or unchanged card set is a defect.
The shared care-promise strip and header nav must stay consistent across the home, Treatments, and Fees routes so the three pages read as one clinic; a strip missing from a route is a defect.
Treatment cards, filter tabs, headings, and footer columns should wrap intentionally rather than colliding, overflowing, or fragmenting at 390px.
state_constraints: desktop_home and mobile_home capture the top of the home page: the header wordmark and nav over the gradient hero with the cover photo, the headline 'Unhurried dental care your whole family can settle into.', sub-copy naming Dr. Priya Halvorsen, and the primary call-to-action button.

desktop_treatments and mobile_treatments capture the home-page Treatments services browser scrolled into view: the four filter tabs, the 'Showing 6 of 6 · All care' readout, and the six tagged treatment cards.
desktop_treatments_prevention captures the same browser after the Prevention tab is clicked: the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Prevention' and only the two Prevention cards remain visible.

desktop_treatments_page and mobile_treatments_page capture the dedicated Treatments route (treatments.html) with the shared care-promise strip (carerail--treatments) and the same six-card services browser.
desktop_pricing_page captures the Fees route (pricing.html) with the shared care-promise strip (carerail--pricing) above the three fee cards.
desktop_stories, desktop_notes, and desktop_footer capture the patient-stories band, the dental-notes cards, and the CTA + dark footer of the home page.

Source inspection confirms the site is static under public/ with a prebuilt Tailwind stylesheet, a small treatfilter.js wiring the category filter, and local cover/SVG assets; the three routes share the header nav and .carerail strip.

change_completion: The Treatments services browser shows six category-tagged cards, four filter tabs, and a 'Showing 6 of 6 · All care' readout on both the home page and the dedicated Treatments page.
Clicking a filter tab re-filters the cards and rewrites the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Label>' matching the clicked category (Prevention → 'Showing 2 of 6 · Prevention').
The shared care-promise strip appears on all three routes and the header links to real Treatments and Fees pages.
The site tells one coherent Marrowbrook Family Dental story with a named lead dentist and no leftover demo or Latin filler.
design_consistency: The layout preserves DentalPro's teal/blue gradient hero, white rounded treatment cards, Inter type scale, Tailwind rhythm, and dark four-column footer across the three routes.
Imagery use stays restrained: the cover photo and four SVG icons, no external stock or generated art.
The result remains a calm clinic marketing site, not a SaaS landing page or magazine.
responsive: 390px home and treatments views have no horizontal overflow and the filter tab row wraps rather than overflowing.
Treatment cards, tabs, headings, and footer columns wrap cleanly without overlapping or clipping on mobile.
regression: Every route still serves statically from public/ with no custom dev server and a clean browser console.
The header nav, care-promise strip, and in-page navigation stay reachable across the home, Treatments, and Fees routes.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Tailwind marketing task on the themewagon dental-pro (Marrowbrook Family Dental) clinic template. The native marketing lever is the clinic's own services browser: six category-tagged treatment cards under a filter tab row with a live 'Showing N of 6' readout, shared across the home page and a dedicated Treatments page, plus a cross-route care-promise strip that also appears on the Fees page. It tests an interactive filter control, a credible layout of the treatment grid and tab row at desktop and 390px mobile, cross-route consistency of the shared strip, and runtime/console cleanliness while reusing the local cover photo and four SVG treatment icons and preserving the DentalPro visual shell. No issue/PR framing.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: themewagon DentalPro single-page static Tailwind dental-clinic template restyled into Marrowbrook Family Dental and extended into a three-route clinic marketing site whose native lever is a treatments services filter (category tabs + live count readout) shared across home and a dedicated Treatments page, with a cross-route care-promise strip on the Fees page; reuses the local cover photo and four SVG treatment icons and the Tailwind shell.
